value.name: Asha waits for the detox worker's answer
value.description: Asha stays on the phone with the detox worker, tense and unwilling to look at Claire while waiting for confirmation about Marcus.
evidence: Asha kept the phone steady at her ear and did not look over, because looking would have made Claire answer for what she had already heard, and the worker was still typing

value.name: Detox worker refuses to confirm hold
value.description: The detox worker says she cannot confirm or deny any court-ordered hold by phone and directs Asha to the public records line.
evidence: The detox worker came back with the careful flatness of someone reading from a screen that did not include what Asha had asked for, said she could not confirm or deny any court-ordered hold by phone, and offered the public records line that would not open until eight.

value.name: Asha ends the call
value.description: Asha thanks the worker and hangs up, ending the immediate attempt to get information by phone.
evidence: Asha thanked her, ended the call

value.name: Rosa texts urgent instructions
value.description: Rosa sends Asha a text telling her to check the state portal immediately before the kids come downstairs.
evidence: felt the phone buzz again under her thumb almost before the screen had darkened: Rosa's text, one line, telling her to open the state portal now and verify the commitment status before the kids hit the stairs

value.name: Claire realizes the search is coming
value.description: Claire watches the phone in silence, signaling that she understands Asha is about to search for Marcus's status.
evidence: she could see at the edge of her vision that Claire was watching the phone now rather than the stairwell, the folded hands in her lap gone still in a way that meant she had understood what the next search was going to look like

value.name: Asha opens the registry portal
value.description: Asha opens the browser, goes to the registry portal, and enters Marcus's name to check his commitment status.
evidence: Asha opened the browser, navigated to the registry portal, and typed Marcus's name into the field

value.name: Asha waits for the portal result
value.description: Asha listens to the quiet kitchen while the portal loads, bracing for what it will reveal about Marcus.
evidence: the kitchen held the small mechanical sounds of the refrigerator and her own breathing while the page took its time deciding what to show her
The page took a beat longer
